basic_details.job_title: Calicut University Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.department: Calicut University Teacher Education Centres (CUTEC, Malappuram)
basic_details.total_vacancies: Assistant Professor on contract in Social Science

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is not exceeding 64 years on the date of notification (08.10.2026).

qualification.details: post: Qualification | assistant professor on contract in social science: a) Postgraduate degree in Social Science with minimum 55% marks. b) M.Ed degree with minimum 55% marks. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate shall have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by UGC. Provided, candidates, who are, or have been awarded PhD degree in Education in accordance with the UGC (Minimum Standard and Procedure for Award of PhD Degree) Regulation 2009, shall be exempted from the requirement of the clearing of NET for appointment as Assistant Professor or equivalent positions in Universities or colleges or institutions.

salary_details.pay_scale: Consolidated amount ranging from Rs. 34,000/- to Rs. 36,000/- per month without D.A and any other allowances

how_to_apply: Visit the official Calicut University website at www.uoc.ac.in to access the online application form.
Submit the filled application through the University website on or before 23/10/2026.
Furnish all required details regarding qualifications and experience in the online application form.
important_instructions: Candidates shortlisted for interview will be informed by email or over phone (land/mobile phone) and also on the website. Original certificates must be submitted for verification during the interview; failure to do so will result in the loss of the candidate's claim to be considered for selection. The University will not pay any TA/DA to candidates for attending the interview. Existing and arising vacancies will be filled up from the rank lists prepared based on this notification.

rows.details: Calicut University Teacher Education Centres (CUTEC, Malappuram)
Assistant Professor on contract in Social Science
Consolidated amount ranging from Rs. 34,000/- to Rs. 36,000/- per month without D.A and any other allowances

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The recruitment is conducted to fill existing and arising vacancies for the B.Ed course at Calicut University Teacher Education Centres.

rows.post_name: Assistant Professor on contract in Social Science

rows.post: Assistant Professor on contract in Social Science
rows.qualification: a) Postgraduate degree in Social Science with minimum 55% marks. b) M.Ed degree with minimum 55% marks. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate shall have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by UGC. Provided, candidates, who are, or have been awarded PhD degree in Education in accordance with the UGC (Minimum Standard and Procedure for Award of PhD Degree) Regulation 2009, shall be exempted from the requirement of the clearing of NET for appointment as Assistant Professor or equivalent positions in Universities or colleges or institutions.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Note: The remuneration is a consolidated amount provided without D.A and any other allowances. Appointment on deputation basis will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit and Relaxation
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is not exceeding 64 years on the date of notification (08.10.2026).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Calicut University Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official Calicut University website at www.uoc.ac.in to access the online application form. Submit the filled application through the University website on or before 23/10/2026. Furnish all required details regarding qualifications and experience in the online application form.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Certificates and testimonials in original Proof of age Proof of qualification Proof of experience Community certificate Equivalency Certificate issued by the University of Calicut (mandatory for candidates possessing degrees from other Universities in Kerala and outside)

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted for interview will be informed by email or over phone (land/mobile phone) and also on the website. Original certificates must be submitted for verification during the interview; failure to do so will result in the loss of the candidate's claim to be considered for selection. The University will not pay any TA/DA to candidates for attending the interview. Existing and arising vacancies will be filled up from the rank lists prepared based on this notification.

faq.question: Q1. Is this post on a permanent basis or contract?
faq.answer: This is a contract basis appointment for the post of Assistant Professor in Social Science at Calicut University Teacher Education Centres.

faq.question: Q2. Are HRA or allowances paid on top of the consolidated pay?
faq.answer: No, the remuneration is a consolidated amount provided without D.A and any other allowances.

faq.question: Q3. What is the upper age limit to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must not exceed 64 years of age on the date of notification (08.10.2026).

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on their qualifications and will be informed about the interview via email, phone, or the official website.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents must be produced during verification?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates must produce original certificates and testimonials for age, qualification, experience, community, along with an Equivalency Certificate from the University of Calicut if degrees are from outside universities.
